name: Elijah
source:
The calm and composed head of the Church of the God of Light, Elijah keeps to himself and rarely lets others in. Beneath his quiet nature, he carries a secret he can't afford to reveal.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419240/Saintess_of_the_Golden_Bow/]Steam[/url]]
